name: user_of
title: user of
body: A Person has actually used a Product. Cite evidence of activity within the product. A successful authentication by itself supports signed_in_to.

name: payable_to
title: payable to
body: A FinancialObligation is payable to the vendor Organization named on the invoice, including an obligation already settled. This relationship does not assert an outstanding balance.

name: Newsletter
title: Newsletters
body: An identifiable recurring publication delivered to recipients by a publisher. Individual issues supply evidence for this publication.

name: HostedEvent
title: Hosted events
body: An identifiable organized event with evidenced registration. A calendar invitation alone does not establish registration or attendance.

name: published_by
title: published by
body: A Newsletter is published by an Organization identified in its masthead or official publication page. Delivery vendors need their own evidence.

name: organized_by
title: organized by
body: A HostedEvent is organized by the named Organization responsible for the event. A venue or ticket processor alone does not establish the organizer.

name: recipient_of
title: recipient of
body: A Person received an issue of a Newsletter. Receipt alone does not establish paid subscription, readership, use, or a purchase.

name: registered_for
title: registered for
body: A Person has a confirmed registration for a HostedEvent. An invitation is insufficient. Attendance requires separate evidence.

name: signed_in_to
title: signed in to
body: A Person successfully authenticated to a Product. A challenge, invitation or failed attempt is insufficient. Feature use requires separate evidence.

name: provided_by
title: provided by
body: A Product is provided or operated by the named Organization. Its operator may differ from its developer.
